title: coaching-tackle-list-1to1-noelle-park-sep03-2026
content:
Purpose: quick, pragmatic 1:1 prep for my report (Samir) — focus on delivery, unblock plan, and a short career sync. Keep to 30m.

Agenda (30m total)
- 0-3m: Personal check-in (energy, time off, anything urgent)
- 3-12m: Delivery review (current sprint tasks + risks)
  - quick status on ticket batch: JIRA-4821 (KV cache perf patch), JIRA-4879 (autoscaler edgecase)
  - pick 1 risky item to deep-dive (if it’s still risky)
- 12-20m: Blockers & unblock plan (owners + concrete next steps)
- 20-27m: Career signal / growth micro-commit (30-90 day focus)
- 27-30m: Quick action items and wrap (who does what, by when)

Notes to self (prep reminders)
- Samir shipped great perf bench last month; start convo acknowledging that first — positive reinforcement.
- He tends to overbook focus time; ask if any meetings can be trimmed this sprint.
- Bring up mentorship slot I floated (pairing with Priya on kernel selection). See if still interested.

Delivery items I expect him to report on
- KV cache perf patch (JIRA-4821) — expected perf lift 8–12% on 8k token workloads. Ask for flaky test list and perf-run logs location.
- Autoscaler edgecase (JIRA-4879) — ask whether root cause is race on instance registration vs billing threshold.
- Canary rollout of quantized-llama-v2 (internal experiment) — check rollback criteria and telemetry alerts.

Open questions to surface to Samir
- Do you have confidence metrics from the last two perf runs? Where are the raw numbers (S3 path or bench harness)?
- Which test is consistently flaky and blocking CI? Rough ETA to stabilize?
- Is the autoscaler issue reproducible in staging with a small repro script?

Blockers + suggested unblocks (talking points)
- Flaky test in integration: suggest he pins the env and I can free up 4h of infra time to repro and iterate. Offer to raise to SRE if repro requires infra tweaks.
- Perf regression after rebase: ask if bisect PRs exist; if not, propose a fast rollback + small incremental PRs.
- Prioritization friction: remind him we can swap lower-priority stories and I will flag with PM.

Career / growth quick sync (8 minutes)
- Check interest in senior-II IC path vs horizontal lead: ask which problems he wants more ownership of (architecture vs mentoring).
- Micro-commit for quarter: ship one cross-team doc (short spec) and run one brown-bag. That becomes evidence for pairing/mentorship.
- Offer: sponsor a 1:1 introduction to infra-arch meetings — can shadow for 2 sessions.

Feedback I’ll give (one positive, one constructive)
- Positive: his perf harness work is thoughtful and reproducible; call out specific PR (runtime/pull/214) and metrics.
- Constructive: wants cleaner PR diffs — suggest breaking the KV work into perf-only + refactor PRs next time.

Action items (after meeting)
- Samir: attach perf run artifacts to JIRA-4821 and add minimal repro steps for flaky test (due: Sep 07).
- Noelle (me): block 4 hours of infra lab time this week to help repro flaky integration test; confirm with SRE (due: Sep 05).
- Samir: draft a 1-page spec for the kernel-selection proposal and share for feedback (due: Sep 21).
- Noelle: introduce Samir to Priya for mentorship pairing; set up 3-week pilot (due: Sep 06).

Quick phrasing cheats (to keep meeting efficient)
- If Samir diverges into too much detail: "Can we capture the deep details in the ticket and I’ll review after this call? For now, what decision do you need from me?"
- If he asks for more headcount: "What’s the one deliverable you'd accelerate with an extra engineer? Let’s scope that and I’ll follow up with PM."

Follow-ups to log in this doc after meeting
- Meeting summary (1–2 lines) + final action items + updated due dates.
- If there’s a risky regression, escalate note to eng-oncall channel and include short recommended rollback plan.

Scratch (things to remember later)
- Check Samir’s PTO for late Sep — if he’s OOO, ensure kernel selection doc has an owner.
- Revisit whether the mentorship pairing should be formalized into a monthly sync if successful.

References / quick links to paste in chat during meeting
- Perf bench S3: s3://redwood-data/perf-runs/2026/aug/kv-cache/
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/214
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-4821

Tone notes: keep it coach-first, action-oriented, short. Prioritize removing friction so Samir can ship.

-- end of prep. Write a 1-line summary here after the meeting and update actions.
